variables: See-through tint that sets an area one step apart from whatever it sits on: the page, a card, a panel. Brand950 at 6% in light (a step darker), Brand50 at 6% in dark (a step lighter), so it carries the brand hue. Use it for a panel inside a panel, a table stripe or inline code, on neutral surfaces only. Put it on one layer only: tints add up when nested. Text on it is checked against the darkest surface it can sit on. Fields keep surface-field.
Hover on an area tinted with surface-alpha. Brand950 at 10% in light, Brand50 at 10% in dark. One layer only, as surface-alpha.

Border of an unchecked checkbox or radio box, at rest and on hover. Meets 3:1 against the page in both modes, since the box is the only mark of the control. Checked boxes use Control/checked-*; disabled ones Border/border-subtle.
Dimension primitive of 320px. Spacing, Sizing, Stroke and Corner Radius tokens alias units; do not bind layers to it directly.
Popover width for Size=sm (256), Menu's width: a profile or filter panel. In code it is capped at the screen width less space-sm each side.
Popover width for Size=md (320), the default: a Share panel with a field, a small form. In code it is capped at the screen width less space-sm each side.
Popover panel surface. Same primitives as Menu/surface-rest: Neutral0 in light, lifted to Neutral900 in dark so the floating panel reads above the page.
Popover outline (stroke-sm, inside). Same primitives as Menu/border: Neutral100 in light, Neutral800 in dark, one step lighter than the dark surface.

One cycle of a loading Skeleton pulse: the fill eases from Surface/surface-alpha to surface-alpha-hover and back, repeated while loading (a loop, not a one-off animation). 1600ms, paired with easing/in-out. Static under reduced motion. Code: duration/pulse.
Spinner size 32, for a section or card loading. Smaller spinners use icon/*.
Spinner size 48, for a whole page or large panel loading. Smaller spinners use icon/*.
Width and height of an extra small digit box in Numeric Input Field. Boxes are square. Below the touch target: for dense layouts.

Brand950 at 6% opacity: a deep brand tint. Follows the source color. The light field fills (Surface/surface-field, surface-alpha, TextInput/surface-rest, Dropdown/surface-rest, Messaging/surface-messagebar), so a see-through fill carries the brand hue the way the tinted grays do. Named for what it is, not its step, so the source can move without a rename.
Brand950 at 10% opacity. Follows the source color. The light field hovers (Surface/surface-field-hover, surface-alpha-hover, TextInput/surface-hover, Dropdown/surface-hover).
Brand50 at 6% opacity: a pale brand tint, the dark mirror of AlphaDeep6. Follows the source color. The dark field fills.
Brand50 at 10% opacity, the dark mirror of AlphaDeep10. Follows the source color. The dark field hovers.

Selected sidebar item fill when Selected style is raised: white in light with Elevation/neutral/near, Neutral800 in dark (one step above the surface-200 panel, which is Neutral900 like surface-raised). Label text-bold, icon icon-bold. No hover change.
Count box on a raised selected sidebar item (Selected style raised): one step above Sidebar/surface-selected-raised. Count label text-subtle.
